visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young man with short black hair (Joeman) sits cross-legged on a white plush rug in a modern living room. He wears a black t-shirt and light blue jeans, pointing toward a large grey robot vacuum base station on his left. The room features a white cabinet with plants and warm studio lighting. (2) Close-up shot of the robot vacuum docking into its base. Blue digital light beams represent power transferring into the machine's battery. A digital overlay shows a battery percentage charging rapidly. (3) A screen recording of a mobile application interface in Traditional Chinese appears, highlighting "PowerBoost" settings and various charging cycles. (4) The robot vacuum moves across a light-colored wooden floor, picking up hair and dirt. A CGI animation reveals the internal blue fan mechanism and airflow path with technical text overlays for suction power. (5) Close-up of the vacuum's underside showing a white microfiber roller brush. The robot traverses liquid stains (coffee and juice) on the floor, effectively cleaning them in one pass. (6) Joeman is seen again, reaching into the top of the base station to pull out two cleaning solution cartridges, one grey and one blue, explaining the dual-tank system. (7) Final shot returns to Joeman seated on the rug, speaking enthusiastically to the camera as the robot vacuum rests in its station beside him.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A male speaker begins with a high-pitched, enthusiastic greeting. He speaks quickly with a professional broadcast quality. The background music is a steady, upbeat electronic track with a punchy synth bass. (2) A sharp 'whoosh' sound effect triggers a transition. The speaker continues describing tech specs as digital ping SFX denote the appearance of text on screen. (3) A subtle mechanical 'whir' of a vacuum motor is heard faintly behind the BGM during cleaning demonstrations. The speaker's arousal level increases as he mentions 'PowerBoost'. (4) A wet suction sound effect is prominently mixed as the vacuum cleans liquid, followed by a mechanical 'click' when a cartridge is removed. (5) The speaker concludes with a rising intonation and energetic tone, matched by a final rhythmic beat from the BGM before fading out.
